patch_description: The current program uses slow finite-difference gradients (52 extra full area evaluations per iteration), few effective restarts, and a weak regular-polygon seed bias. The new version replaces finite differences with exact analytic gradients of the LogSumExp soft-min objective (computed via bincount accumulation over the 286 triples, ~50x cheaper per iteration), which allows many more optimization iterations and restarts within the same time budget. Key parameter changes: annealed sharpness p from 40→400 (stronger late focus on the worst triangle), 400 iterations per restart (vs 220), 24 diverse seeds (regular 13-gon, double rings with varied radii/offsets, hexagonal clusters, jittered lattices, and seeded random), and cosine-decayed learning rate. The final configuration is selected by the true normalized score (min triangle area / hull area), with duplicate-point safety and a deterministic fallback.
